name: EspAudio
description: Teensy-Audio-style DSP helpers for ESP32-S3/P4, plus AudioStreamGraph — a runtime that renders a CraftAudio patch as DATA, and AudioStreamControl — patch-generic live param writes over SysEx (bring your own isystem_dsp_kernels.h). Public MIT subset — not commercial Octopus ROM. AudioGranularOla is caller-PCM only (no SD WAV decoder).
